content.title: Submission Desk Rejected by Program Chairs
content.desk_reject_comments:
The paper has been desk-rejected due to serious cases of plagiarism. Examples:

- Figure 1 is 100% copy/paste from [1] (the authors state "adopted from"), including the caption
- Table 1 is a screenshot from [1] (the authors state "adopted from"), caption is copy/paste without any attribution
- Table 2: pretty much as [1], but there are some replacements (e.g.: Android <- iPhone5, phone <- kindle, kitchen <- room, shirt <- clothing)
- Table 3: copied first 3 rows from [1] without attribution, row 4 is new (and performs worse than row 4 in [1])
- Algorithm 1 is a screenshot from [2]; no attribution

[1] CAT-Gen: Improving Robustness in NLP Models via Controlled Adversarial Text Generation. Wang et al. EMNLP 2020.
[2] FreeLB: Enhanced Adversarial Training for Natural Language Understanding. Zhu et al. ICLR 2020.
